out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink, located by the 3 vat.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM replaced paper towels at the hand sink for compliance. Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located near the 3 vat is blocked by containers and equipment in sink, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the items from the sink for compliance. A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters were stored in buckets that registered 0ppm for chemical sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM replaced the sanitizer buckets with solution that registered at 200ppm for compliance during the inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the hand sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Work order has been submitted.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed cutting boards, knives and spatulas located at the prep top that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI sanitized or exchanged.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3 compartment sink with a concentration of 0ppm total quaternary ammonium compound. Observed dishes soaking in sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CDI new sanitizer sink made.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: deli ham from 4/25/25
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI discarded

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system at mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI attachment removed.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: roasted garlic base from last month.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI. Discarded.
